_comment: This is the JSON configuration file to run the INS Algorithms.

log._comment: Configuration of the Log File (Possible values: DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, FATAL).

algorithm._comment: Select the INS algorithm to execute (Possible options are: Sensor Emulator, Free Integration, Loosely Coupled)

reference_position._comment: available forms are LLA (latitude,longitude,altitude), LLD (latitude,longitude,down) or ECEF (cartesian x,y,z)

reference_velocity._comment: available frames: navigation n (v_eb^n), body b (v_eb^b), ECEF e (v_eb^e)

output._comment: select output folder (absolute path) to store the run. Set 'default' to store in default path runs/
